artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \ge 1$ and write $\widehat{E}$ for the polynomially convex hull of a compact set $E \subset \mathbb{C}^n$, i.e.
$$\widehat{E} \;=\; \bigl\{ z \in \mathbb{C}^n : |p(z)| \le \sup_{w \in E} |p(w)| \text{ for every holomorphic polynomial } p \bigr\}.$$
Suppose $K \subset \mathbb{C}^n \setminus \{0\}$ is compact and that $0 \in \widehat{K}$. Suppose further that $L \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ is a (not necessarily compact) subset that contains an open neighborhood of $K$, and set
$$\widehat{L} \;=\; \bigcup \bigl\{ \widehat{F} : F \subset L \text{ compact} \bigr\}.$$
Question: must $\widehat{L}$ contain an open neighborhood of the origin $0$ in $\mathbb{C}^n$?

artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in a community problem list in several complex variables (the "Runge problem" item). No subsequent publication located via web search explicitly resolves this specific formulation about neighborhoods of $0$ in $\widehat L$, and standard surveys of polynomial convexity do not list it as settled. Status could not be verified.
